title: sister_deleted_my_run
beats: My sister (24F) deleted eleven months of my parkour clips to "teach me a lesson," and I found out mid-livestream.
I'm (28F), I run a small Minecraft parkour channel, nothing huge, but those clips were my backup footage too.
She's mad because I wouldn't let her stream on my account for her own "clout," so she used my laptop while I was in the shower.
Came back to a chat full of "why is the screen black" and an empty recordings folder, all 340 files gone.
I confronted her, she said "it's just blocks, grow up," like a year of 3am grinding was nothing.
Our mom is siding with her, says I "provoked" her by saying no in the first place.
I backed up nothing to the cloud because I trusted her not to touch my stuff, that's on me too, I know.
I filed a police report anyway, just to scare her, and it worked, she's not speaking to me now.
So, Reddit... AITAH for calling the cops over deleted Minecraft footage?
